name: nestjs-nextjs
description: Full-stack NestJS + Next.js development workflow — TDD, Figma design integration, browser verification, and doc governance. Combines the full w-task workflow suite (intake → context → plan → impact → UI/Figma → TDD → browser-verify → docs → PR) with the f-* Figma skill suite and Chrome DevTools MCP for localhost UI verification. v0.3.0 workflow v2: per-repo/submodule default branches (main vs master) via workflow.yaml repos[], terminal one-PR-per-repo Phase 6, and w-setup version detection + auto-migration. DEPRECATED as of v0.4.0 — superseded by `nextjs-combo`, which is the maintained successor (official Figma MCP suite, Figma subagents, visual parity gate, infra security review). v0.4.0 only extends the `figma` preset so existing installs keep working with w-task's engine-aware Phase 3; no further features will land here. v0.5.0 is likewise a compatibility bump only — it installs the two skills workflow v3 added (`w-codegraph`, `w-acceptance-verify`) so existing installs keep working with the updated w-task. New work belongs in `nextjs-combo`.

external_setup.name: mgrep
external_setup.notes: Semantic code search plugin. settings_patch registers the Mixedbread-Grep marketplace and auto-enables the plugin.

external_setup.name: figma
external_setup.install_hint: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp — then run /mcp and authorise in the browser. For the local server instead, enable the MCP server in Figma desktop (Preferences) and point the url at http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp.
external_setup.notes: This is NOT the legacy @figma/mcp REST server. The official server provides get_design_context, get_metadata, get_variable_defs, get_screenshot, get_code_connect_map and a localhost asset endpoint — the rendered reference and real asset exports the legacy REST server never had. A project that keeps the old f-* suite installed must not register both under the name `figma`.

external_setup.name: chrome-devtools
external_setup.install_hint: Auto-installs via npx. Requires Node.js and Google Chrome 144+.
external_setup.notes: Used by w-task Phase 4c for localhost UI verification. Phase 4c is skipped gracefully when dev_server_command is not set in workflow.yaml.
